# Third-party files

Served from this site instead of from CDNs, so visitors' browsers do not
contact other servers, and the page keeps working if a CDN is down.

| File | Source | License |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `aframe-1.4.2.min.js` | <https://aframe.io/releases/1.4.2/aframe.min.js> | MIT, [LICENSE-aframe.txt](LICENSE-aframe.txt) |
| `aframe-extras-6.1.1.min.js` | <https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/donmccurdy/aframe-extras@v6.1.1/dist/aframe-extras.min.js> | MIT, [LICENSE-aframe-extras.txt](LICENSE-aframe-extras.txt) |
| `../fonts/quicksand-latin.woff2` | Google Fonts, Quicksand, Latin subset | SIL OFL 1.1, [OFL-Quicksand.txt](../fonts/OFL-Quicksand.txt) |
| `../fonts/yuji-boku-latin.woff2` | Google Fonts, Yuji Boku, Latin subset | SIL OFL 1.1, [OFL-YujiBoku.txt](../fonts/OFL-YujiBoku.txt) |

To update a library, download the new version here, change the file name in
`index.html` and delete the old file.

The fonts cover Latin characters only. Japanese text in Yuji Boku would need
more of the font (Google Fonts serves it in about 120 pieces).
